evidence.quote: The programme follows international standards and is therefore 100% in English.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: all countries 9,080 EUR

Begin your application by submitting the following documents: Curriculum vitae in tabular form Proof of a general higher education entrance qualification or a foreign school-leaving certificate recognised as equivalent.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states 9,080 EUR per semester for applicants from 'all countries'; this is the figure used for a non-EU applicant (a different, Master-specific fee schedule PDF was ignored). Application channel: no page states that foreign applicants use uni-assist or a VPD; the EBS pages describe a fully digital application via EBS's own Bewerbungsportal, so de-university-direct was chosen. Deadlines: EBS states there are no application deadlines (DAAD page: 'There are no application deadlines at EBS.'), so no intake dates were output; the visa-related dates are recommendations only and are recorded as a manual_check. Documents: the list covers the two items named by the DAAD page ('Curriculum vitae in tabular form' and 'foreign school-leaving certificate'); no quote about translation requirements was found, so translationRequired is null.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT (since 2026): 4 Reading: 4 Listening: 4 Speaking: 4 Writing: 4 IELTS Academic: 5.5

note.fr: Test de connaissances (mathématiques/logique, ~30 min), test de personnalité (~20 min) et entretien individuel de 30 minutes font partie du processus de sélection.
note.en: Knowledge test (mathematical/logical-analytical, ~30 min), personality test (~20 min) and a 30-minute individual interview are part of the selection process.

evidence.quote: We use the knowledge test to assess your mathematical and logical-analytical abilities as well as your problem-solving skills, which are necessary for successfully completing your studies.

note.fr: Aucune date limite officielle : si vous avez besoin d'un visa, il est recommandé de postuler avant le 30 mai (semestre d'hiver) ou le 15 octobre (semestre d'été).
note.en: No official application deadline: if you need a visa, it is recommended to apply before 30 May (winter semester) or 15 October (summer semester).

evidence.quote: For international applicants who require a visa, we recommend that you submit your application before 30 May (for a start in the winter semester) or 15 October (for a start in the summer semester).
